Design corrected during T7: wiki layer must be its own storage files, not new kinds inside nodes.jsonl/edges.jsonl. Five production call sites (wiki/service.ts:365,412; wiki/collect.ts:97; commands/update.ts:869) treat every non-asset node as a source file, so a wiki-page node would be grouped by moduleNameFromProjectPath into a fabricated module and would corrupt validModuleNames — the exact module set wikiPruneOrphans and sac/lifecycle-flag.ts rely on. AC1/AC2/AC7 restated against the layer files and a build manifest; AC13 added to pin the no-regression guarantee
